data.body: Reproduced and fixed in Gerrit 3260 (963632fc745). Repro: git wrapper execs sleep for ls-tree under a 1 s _GIT_TIMEOUT; a tree holding gitlink vendor/sub wrote {"submodules": []} to <sha>.caveats.json and a later healthy materialize still returned (). Root cause: _list_submodules parsed ls-tree stdout without checking the outcome. Fix: raise SnapshotError on a watchdog timeout (git_fetch._raise_if_timed_out -> git_outcome.is_watchdog_timeout) and on any non-zero exit, matching _materialize_tree's read-tree handling; attested mode already fails closed, and the published entry is left without a sidecar so the next call recomputes. Tests: tests/unit/test_snapshot_submodules_watchdog_c605.py (4 of 5 failed before the fix, 5/5 pass after); 1233 passed across 79 snapshot-related test files; make lint and make typecheck clean.
